 Fantasy Football Outlook: Will Saquon Barkley Play Week 7? 
 Here’s the latest injury updates for Saquon Barkley .
 Saquon Barkley (hamstring) practicing again Friday 
 Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is taking part in Philadelphia’s practice again on Friday.
 Barkley is practicing in a second-straight practice on Friday. It’s unclear whether or not he is limited in any capacity, but either way, this is a good sign that he will be back in the lineup for Monday night’s game against Dallas.

 What the Experts Are Saying 
 Our injury model gives Saquon Barkley a 74% chance to play this week.
 Week 7 expert consensus rankings have Barkley ranked as the RB19.
 His injury is listed on the injury report as: Hamstring
 He was a Limited Participant on Thursday, a Limited Participant on Friday, and a Full Participant on Saturday.
 Saquon Barkley will be back this week. In his two full games this season, he has averaged 16 touches and 80 total yards with RB29 and RB30 finishes in weekly scoring. Barkley has posted a strong 11.8% explosive run rate and 22% missed tackle rate this season. With the Eagles’ injuries to their pass-catching depth chart, Barkley could be leaned on heavily this week. Since Week 3, the Cowboys’ run defense has improved, allowing the eighth-lowest rushing success rate, the seventh-lowest missed tackle rate, and ranking 16th in yards after contact per attempt allowed. Behind an offensive line that, since Week 3, has had the sixth-lowest yards before contact per attempt, Barkley might not find much running room this week.
– Saquon Barkley
